description: Native phone capture, 1080x2340, no overlays. Calibrated on uz4VVzGlOjE.

notes.ability_right: Mighty Miner ability button. States seen: available (bright blue, pink cost pip), unavailable (dark blue, grey pip).
notes.ability_left: Mirrored from ability_right. Only appears when a second hero/champion ability exists; never in Alina's usual deck.
notes.my_king_hp: Not calibrated: only shown once the POV king tower is damaged.
notes.slotN_tab: Evo cards have a tab with charge pips; champion/hero cards have a pointed frame.
notes.slotN: Top extended to 1950: a selected card is raised ~31px (card-art top ~1981 vs ~2012).
notes.emote_panel: The emote picker covers the whole hand bar (e.g. 521s). Readers must detect it and return 'occluded'.
notes.next: A '1sec' countdown can overlay the bottom-left of the next card right after a play.
